publications.title: F1® Drivers make their LEGO® Minifigure debut in new Speed Champions collection revealed at the FORMULA 1® LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX
publications.summary: Formula 1 November 18, 2026 F1® Drivers make their LEGO® Minifigure debut in new Speed Champions collection revealed at the FORMULA 1® LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX The LEGO Group and Formula 1 unveiled the new LEGO Speed Champions Formula 1® collection, featuring all F1 drivers as LEGO Minifigures for the first time ever and all-new LEGO versions of the 11 F1 teams’ 2026 regulation cars.

publications.title: LEGO Manufacturing Vietnam powers on battery energy storage system
publications.summary: Press Releases November 18, 2026 LEGO Manufacturing Vietnam powers on battery energy storage system LEGO Manufacturing Vietnam has powered on its battery energy storage system, developed in partnership with Vietnam–Singapore Industrial Park (VSIP), marking a key milestone in the company’s ambition to operate its Vietnam factory using renewable energy.

publications.title: A galaxy built brick by brick: New LEGO® Star Wars™ 7-piece collection revealed for the 50th anniversary of Star Wars™
publications.summary: Star Wars November 12, 2026 A galaxy built brick by brick: New LEGO® Star Wars™ 7-piece collection revealed for the 50th anniversary of Star Wars™ Ahead of the 50th anniversary of Star Wars next year, the LEGO Group announces a new wave of seven exciting LEGO® Star Wars™ building sets, all available from January 1st, 2027. The seven-set collection spans artwork, vehicles, helmets and display models inspired by iconic moments from across the Star Wars saga since 1977.

publications.title: The King of the Monsters awakens: First-ever LEGO® set featuring Godzilla from Legendary’s Monsterverse® unveiled
publications.summary: Products November 3, 2026 The King of the Monsters awakens: First-ever LEGO® set featuring Godzilla from Legendary’s Monsterverse® unveiled Legendary’s Monsterverse Godzilla enters the LEGO Group portfolio with the LEGO® Ideas Godzilla (21375) set: a towering, 5,363-piece tribute to the King of Monsters and the largest LEGO Ideas model ever launched.

publications.title: LEGO® Friends reveal three new sets at magical Unicorn Café pop-up
publications.summary: Products October 28, 2026 LEGO® Friends reveal three new sets at magical Unicorn Café pop-up the LEGO Group unveiled three new LEGO® Friends sets, launching 1 January 2027. The reveal took place at the LEGO Friends Unicorn Café pop-up at Potters Fields Park, London, which is opened for fans from 29–31 October, 2026.

publications.title: The LEGO Group teams up with Sesame Street to inspire young children to fall in love with nature
publications.summary: Responsibility October 27, 2026 The LEGO Group teams up with Sesame Street to inspire young children to fall in love with nature The LEGO Group and Sesame Workshop, the global nonprofit behind Sesame Street, have launched three new videos, funded by the LEGO Foundation, encouraging children aged 4 to 6 to discover the natural world through play. Featuring Elmo, Cookie Monster and other Sesame Street friends, the videos introduce children to bats, butterflies and worms before inviting them to build habitats using LEGO bricks and everyday craft materials. The LEGO Group’s free activity guides and printables help families and educators extend the experience through hands-on play at home and in community settings.

publications.title: Builders After All: The LEGO Group and DAFT PUNK™ announce partnership – blending worlds of music, culture and creative experimentation
publications.summary: Partnerships October 22, 2026 Builders After All: The LEGO Group and DAFT PUNK™ announce partnership – blending worlds of music, culture and creative experimentation The LEGO Group and DAFT PUNK™ are proud to announce a new partnership that aims to inspire and remix fandoms, with the Daft Punk robots entering the LEGO universe. Spanning product, content and brand experiences, the collaboration celebrates the creativity and communities that have shaped the legacy of both brands.

publications.title: Ciao, Venice: The LEGO Group floats new Icons set
publications.summary: Products October 15, 2026 Ciao, Venice: The LEGO Group floats new Icons set The LEGO Group reveals the LEGO® Icons Venetian Neighbourhood (11388) set. With 5,682 pieces, this is one of the most intricate city dioramas in the LEGO Icons collection and marks the first time the LEGO Group has created a cityscape-style display model of this scale, inviting builders to capture the romance, rhythm and remarkable architecture of Venice with LEGO elements – no passport required.
